additional_info.subject: RE: ID0440120-DC/Si-D/SA- [MP/RN 170002909] Issue with screen CRM:02684000441
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
As per issue reported by the end customer, display is not working.
Kindly perform the following steps onsite to resolve the issue:
1.Please reboot the charger.
2.You will need to change the DP cable. Please replace the DP cable with a new 1.5m cable (Official Siemens spare part and NOT any other DP cable). Also please route the DP cable as far as possible from routers and avoid any loop on the cable, R&D found out that this component is affecting the EMC performance.
3.Also please check the 24VDC power supply. it should be set to 25VDC.
Please find below attached Q feedback and knowledge article link for your reference.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SID_HW_Black screen_ FC14 flashing red - Dynamics 365
SI E Q-Feedback Q2301 Sicharge D - HMI Blackout Due To RFID Illumination - ID: 109816643 - Industry Support Siemens

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0440120-DC/Si-D/SA- [MP/RN 170002909] Issue with screen CRM:02684000441
additional_info.body:
The customer has confirmed that all troubleshooting steps were done. The customer informed siemens team prior to the mobilization, this site is restricted to bring camera phones and internet connectivity. The customer checked the charger – HMI controller updates similar to case 0420567. But the HMI update failed similar to the case 0420567. The HMI controller receiving power and connected to the controller update software but failed to respond for the firmware update. The cables I2C to USB cable and tools we used for this rectification is provided by siemens.
Thanks,
Mohamed

additional_info.subject: ID0440120-DC/Si-D/SA- [MP/RN 170002909] Issue with screen CRM:02684000441
additional_info.body:
Dear Mohamed,
Today we checked together this case after the feedback from the field. To summarize our conversation:
Pictures of the charger and components could not be taken due to security reason (charger is located in Royal Palace)
Onsite technicians assessed that symptoms are same as per other charger Y2 / R4 312922184008 in ticket ID0420567 .
Symptoms are: HMI off, 24V present on HMI's control board, LEDs on PCB not turning on, PCB not reachable via Software.
Based on these statements, I can confirm to replace the HMI of the charger. Here are the spare parts to be ordered:
BR
Fosco
